newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Raymond down 10 pct on results.
newsitem.headline: India's Raymond down 10 pct on results.

text.p: Shares of Indian diversified firm Raymond Ltd fell six rupees, or nearly 10 percent, to 54.75 in early trade on the Bombay bourse on Thursday after the firm announced a fall in its 1996/97 net profit, traders said.
Raymond said after market hours on Wednesday its net profit plunged to 88.84 million rupees in the year ended March 31, from 957.61 in the previous year.
The company said it had cut dividend to 1.0 rupee a share, from 5.0 rupees in 1995/96.
Analysts said profits had plunged due to high interest costs and poor demand for most of the firm's products. Raymonds has diversified interests in cement, textiles and steel.
Raymond raised $60 million through an issue of global depositary receipts in November 1994.
